candidates.analysis_summary: [MILESTONE] PDUFA goal date 2026-11-01 (90 days out); sNDA submitted 2026-05-12, Priority Review granted 2026-07-07. No AdComm announced as of 2026-07-30 Q2 update. | The catalyst is real, hard-dated, forward and un-run: FDA accepted the mitapivat sNDA with Priority Review on 2026-07-07 with a PDUFA goal date of 2026-11-01, re-confirmed in the 2026-07-30 Q2 release. The setup is unusual because the stock has fallen through the entire post-acceptance window — $44.01 on the Priority Review print, $37.36 on the 2026-07-21 tebapivat SCD discontinuation (actual one-day move was -6.7%, not the ~-14% the triage note claimed; the -14% figure conflates the tebapivat day with the separate -16% two-day slide after the 2026-07-30 Q2 print), and $30.55 today. That last leg matters and is not a class read-across: it followed earnings, where AQVESME thalassemia scripts added 200 in Q2 versus 242 in Q1, i.e. a decelerating launch, which is a base-business concern independent of the PDUFA. Capital structure is clean and needs no waterfall haircut — $964.8M cash at 6/30/26 versus a $1.82B market cap on ~59.7M shares is ~$16.2/share of net cash with no preferred stack, so enterprise value is ~$860M against a mitapivat franchise already running $44.7M/quarter (vs $12.5M a year prior) and approved in the US, EU, UAE and Saudi. On that math the SCD indication is close to free at today's price. The honest offset, and why this is a 7 rather than an 8: approval is genuinely uncertain, not merely unpriced. This is accelerated approval on a hemoglobin-response surrogate after RISE UP missed on annualized pain-crisis rate (the November 2025 miss that spawned the Levi & Korsinsky / Pomerantz / Gross securities investigations still running), and FDA's confidence in Hb response as an SCD surrogate was damaged by the 2024 global withdrawal of Oxbryta, the prior Hb-surrogate accelerated approval in this exact indication. Tebapivat's Phase 2 failure is also not purely noise — Agios' own language, that response rates were "consistent with the class" but not differentiated, is a mild negative datapoint on PK-activator effect size, even though the discontinuation was a portfolio decision rather than a safety or mechanism failure.

catalyst_3.title: Verify
catalyst_3.evidence: Attempted kill FAILED on every axis, but the instrument rationale needs correcting. All load-bearing facts confirm against primary sources: the 2026-07-07 Agios PR states FDA Priority Review for the mitapivat sNDA in SCD with a PDUFA goal date of November 1, 2026, re-confirmed verbatim in the 2026-07-30 Q2 release, which also states $44.7M mitapivat Q2 revenue (vs $12.5M Q2-25), $964.8M cash at 6/30/26, and 442 cumulative AQVESME scripts; the 2026-07-21 PR confirms tebapivat SCD discontinuation with Hb response "consistent with the class of medicine" but not differentiated. The line's own correction of the triage note is itself correct: 07-20 $40.06 to 07-21 $37.36 = -6.7%, not -14%. ALREADY-HARVESTED fails hard in the line's favor: pre-catalyst base was $37.39 (07-06), acceptance popped to $44.01, and the stock is now $30.48 — 18% BELOW the pre-catalyst base, near the 52wk low of $22.24 against a $46 high. Nothing captured; unfired AND unpriced, which is rare. NUMERATOR PROVENANCE passes cleanly — the Q2 balance sheet shows preferredStock 0 and longTermDebt 0, so no pref redemption, PIK step-up, or external-manager fee leakage exists to haircut; the upside is a direct cash-vs-EV frame, not an inherited analyst target. CORRECTIONS: (1) the two-day post-Q2 slide is -14.3% on closes ($35.01 on 07-29 to $30.02 on 07-31), not the -16% claimed; (2) the "$16.2/sh net cash floors the downside" claim is overstated twice — $31.2M of capital-lease obligations nets it to ~$15.6/sh, and the floor is ERODING at ~$1.7/sh per quarter (retained earnings ran -$561.7M to -$761.5M across two quarters, ~$100M/qtr burn), so a Nov-1 CRL lands on a melting floor, not a static one, which weakens the sizing case for the common; EV is therefore ~$886M, not ~$860M; (3) the 200-vs-242 script deceleration is arithmetically consistent with the disclosed 442 cumulative but the Q1 242 figure was not independently verified against a primary Q1 disclosure; (4) Pomerantz investigation confirmed via 07-28 and 07-30 releases, Levi & Korsinsky / Gross unverified. The thesis weakness the line already owns is the correct one and is not overstated: accelerated approval rests on a Hb-response surrogate after RISE UP missed on annualized pain-crisis rate, and the 2024 global Oxbryta withdrawal damaged FDA confidence in exactly that surrogate in exactly this indication — the 06-13 EHA release leading with Hb response and only secondarily with pain-crisis benefit "in patients who achieved hemoglobin response" is the tell of a missed endpoint. Tradeable: NASDAQ, $1.82B cap on ~59.7M shares, 0.4-3.4M shares/day, listed options support the Dec-2026 spread. No hidden disqualifier found. Score 7 holds — the negative run-up into a hard-dated forward catalyst is a genuinely favorable setup, offset by real binary approval risk and a downside "floor" that burns.

catalyst_3.title: Verify
catalyst_3.evidence: KILL ATTEMPT FAILED — the line survives, and the gap it flagged resolves in its favor. (1) FEDERAL POSTURE VERIFIED (primary: justice.gov, DOJ Antitrust Division statement, 2026-06-12): DOJ CLOSED its 8-month investigation with NO divestitures, NO behavioral remedies, NO concessions, finding no likely harm in SVOD, linear TV or theatrical; EU, Australia, Austria, Kuwait also cleared. So this IS the states-only Clayton Act posture the line hypothesized — the closest precedent being the 2020 states-only T-Mobile/Sprint suit, which the states LOST after federal clearance. The line's own stated unknown is now a supporting fact, not a hole. (2) TERMS CONFIRMED: $31.00/share all-cash, agreed 2026-02-27 (raised from $30); 2026-07-24 joint stipulation bars closing/integration until the EARLIER of five days after a merits ruling or 2027-06-01 (corroborated by the Colorado AG's own press release, a government primary source); $0.25/share/quarter ticking fee accruing from 2026-09-30; 12 state AGs (Bonta/James coalition) before Judge Araceli Martinez-Olguin; the Aug-3 preliminary-injunction hearing WAS vacated when the standstill was stipulated; WGA/union suit confirmed. (3) ALREADY-HARVESTED TEST FAILS TO KILL — the opposite is true: WBD trades $26.09 vs $31.00 contractual cash = 18.8% gross, ~21.7% including ~$0.75 of accrued ticking fee to June-2027. Price sits BELOW both its 50d ($26.61) and 200d ($26.47) averages and 13% under its $30 52wk high — the announcement re-rate has been GIVEN BACK on litigation risk, so the payoff is unharvested, not priced. $65B cap, 13.1M shares/day: fully tradeable, no liquidity or borrow disqualifier. (4) NUMERATOR PROVENANCE correctly waived — contractual cash to the common, no SoP/preferred/waterfall/external-manager layer; the FIP failure mode genuinely does not apply. CORRECTIONS: (a) the line's specific competing trial dates (Paramount 2026-11-04 vs states 2027-04-05) are NOT corroborated — what is documented is Paramount seeking a compressed hearing the week of Aug 17/24 and a joint trial-schedule statement due 2026-07-31; treat the exact dates as unverified colour, not load-bearing. (b) The Global Networks-spin correction (suspended, offer conditioned on 100% ownership) could not be independently confirmed inside budget; it is directionally consistent with a single-leg cash arb but should not be cited as verified. RESIDUAL RISK THAT CAPS THIS AT 7 AND NO HIGHER: the downside is a genuinely unquantified fat tail — no break print exists, and standalone WBD absent the bid is plausibly high-teens, so the ~20% upside is paired with a ~25-35% break loss. That means the trade only works if P(close) exceeds roughly 60-65%; the 19% spread IS the market's honest price of that binary, not an oversight. Add ~10 months of duration for a catalyst sleeve biased to shorter fuses. Real, verified, well-documented — but a fairly-priced litigation binary with precedent tilt, not a mispricing.

catalyst_3.evidence: Both legs survive on primary sources, but the framing does not. (1) "The tape has not moved on either headline" is FALSE for the STAR leg: on 7 Jul 2026 FISV popped ~6% pre-market and was the single biggest riser in the S&P 500 on the WSJ report (Barron's/Invezz/Motley Fool "Why Fiserv Stock Topped the Market Today"). (2) The two legs are ONE correlated catalyst, not two: JANA's own primary release (PRNewswire, 30 Jul 2026, "JANA Partners Sends Letter to Fiserv Board of Directors") is headed "Supports Sale of Debit Network / Calls For Comprehensive Review of Entire Asset Portfolio / Believes Further Board Change Needed" — the activist is endorsing the same STAR sale, so there is no second independent shot on goal. This also closes the line's own stated GAP: the demands ARE primary-confirmed, not Reuters-headline-only. (3) Numerator provenance PASSES the hard test — Q1-2026 balance sheet (CIK 0000798354, filed 2026-05-06) shows preferredStock = $0, so there is genuinely no pref stack / PIK / external manager ahead of the common; the FIP failure mode does not apply. But the numbers are sloppy: totalDebt $29.306bn (not $29.18bn), netDebt $28.477bn (the quoted $28.35bn is the Q4-2025 figure), net-debt/EBITDA TTM 3.60x (not ~3.9x), EV/EBITDA TTM 7.27x on ~$7.9bn EBITDA (not 7.9x on $7.3bn) — all errors run conservative, so the mechanical upside is not overstated. (4) NOT already-harvested: at $54.40 the stock sits 16% above its 52wk low ($47.04) and far below both the 50d ($114) and 200d ($166) averages, i.e. the post-headline tape gave back the pop and more. (5) The unflagged disqualifiers are what cap this: the STAR bid's stated rationale is routing around Durbin debit-fee caps (MarketBeat, 9 Jul), so a four-bank consortium buying a debit network is regulatory arbitrage by construction — that raises the DOJ/Fed kill probability well above a routine divestiture; the talks are "preliminary" and have produced no follow-up since 9 Jul (~4 weeks stale); the President resigned 7 Jul citing a "Good Reason" contract clause (PYMNTS/8-K); Ademi LLP is investigating fiduciary-duty claims amid existing lawsuits; and Q2 prints 6 Aug 2026 (confirmed, GlobeNewswire 14 Jul), three days out, into a tape already down ~77% from its 52wk high. G2 fails as the line concedes — nothing is committed. Cut 7 → 6 for the correlated-single-catalyst correction, the false "tape has not moved" premise, and the regulatory-arbitrage kill risk; kept ACTIVE because the event is real, forward, primary-sourced and the waterfall is clean.

catalyst_3.title: Verify
catalyst_3.evidence: Event and waterfall survive primary-source attack; the valuation framing does not. Q1-2026 10-Q (filed 2026-05-06) confirms verbatim: "we expect the interim analysis for OS in IMpactMF may occur in the second half of 2026 and the final analysis may occur in the second half of 2028" - registrational Ph3, int-2/high-risk R/R MF post-JAKi, OS primary, fully enrolled Sept 2025. Unfired (only 8-K since May is the 2026-05-27 annual-meeting/equity-plan item). Provenance re-derivation is ACCURATE: preferredStock=0, "$341.0 million in cash" verbatim, total debt $251.8M (Pharmakon $125M Tranche A term loan + Royalty Pharma synthetic royalty), net cash ~$89M, clean common waterfall - not a FIP-style mirage. Not harvested: $1.27 sits BELOW the 50d ($1.32) and 200d ($1.40), 37% off the 52wk high ($2.01), only 22% above the low ($1.04) - zero pre-catalyst re-rate, so the free-option framing is real. CORRECTIONS, all cutting the same direction: (1) shares 669,375,000 confirmed, so EV = 669M x $1.27 - $89M = ~$761M, NOT $726M - the line paired a stale 641M-share market cap with the correct 669M count; (2) that is 3.9x TTM revenue ($196.1M: 51.8+48.0+47.2+49.0), not 3.2x, and NO 2026 revenue guidance appears anywhere in the 10-Q to support the ~$227M denominator the 3.2x implies - the flattering multiple is unsourced; (3) the failure floor re-derives to ~$0.87 at 2.5x TTM plus net cash, ~12% below the claimed $0.95-1.00, and lands BELOW the Nasdaq $1.00 minimum-bid threshold - the 10-Q carries explicit delisting risk-factor language the line never mentions, so the "commercial floor" is also a delisting trigger. Timing softness is confirmed by the issuer's own hedging - "may occur," "Based on our current planning assumptions for event (death) rates" - a modeled OS-event window, not a PDUFA date, with a live inconclusive-interim (IDMC "continue") branch that pays nothing. Scientific risk verified as genuinely high: the 10-Q concedes IMbark support rests on "statistical analyses comparing IMbark data to closely matched real world data," i.e. a non-randomized cross-trial comparison, and that FDA urged a third dosing arm Geron declined. Offsetting fact the line missed and worth crediting: Q1 2026 was essentially operating breakeven (revenue $51.8M vs opex $50.4M, operating income -$0.2M, net -$3.6M vs -$19.8M a year prior) against $341M liquidity, so there is no forced dilution into the window. Net: thesis structurally intact and honestly caveated, but a soft modeled window plus an unsourced multiple and an overstated floor at the delisting line do not support a 7 - trim to 6.

catalyst_3.title: Verify
catalyst_3.evidence: Every load-bearing FACT survives primary verification, but the NUMERATOR does not survive at full strength. Confirmed against issuer primary sources: KBR's 2026-07-30 Q2 FY2026 release states the MTS spin is "targeting completion on January 4, 2027, which is the first business day of fiscal 2027," and the same-day release names it Trinzic (a separate 07-30 release says only "expected to be completed in January 2027" — the specific date comes from the earnings release, so the date is real but is a TARGET, not a declared distribution date). Segment tape confirmed: MTS Q2 rev $1,308M (-2% YoY), adj EBITDA $158M / 12.1%; STS rev $676M (+10%), adj EBITDA $123M / 18.2%; FY26 adj EBITDA guidance $980-1,040M REAFFIRMED; adj EPS guide $3.87-4.22. Balance sheet from the 10-Q filed 2026-07-30 (FY-Q2 ended 2026-07-03) confirms preferredStock $0, total debt $2,798M incl $246M finance leases, cash $312M, net debt $2,486M, ~126-127M shares. EV = $4.68B mkt cap + $2.80B debt - $0.31B cash = $7.16B / $1,010M = 7.09x — the 7.1x is real. Provenance test PASSES: no preferred stack, no PIK, no external manager, no proceeds-diversion language; 100% of any SoP accrues to the common. ALREADY-HARVESTED test PASSES cleanly and is the strongest part of the line: at $37.09 the stock sits 29% below its 52wk high of $52.23, below its $38.92 200d average, and the spin has been public for quarters — this is a de-rated, not a re-rated, tape. CORRECTIONS that cut the score from 7 to 6: (a) the ENTIRE $56-68 rests on an ASSERTED 9.5-11.0x "separated-peer" multiple with no comp sourced — nothing observable supports it, and the sell-side consensus target implies only ~+25% (~$46), which sits BELOW the line's own $48 low case, so the modeled value is above every external mark rather than merely above the tape; (b) segment EBITDA is quoted pre-corporate (MTS $158M + STS $123M = $281M vs $258M consolidated, i.e. ~$92M/yr corporate drag) — the EV math correctly uses consolidated $1,010M so there is no double-count, but standalone-public-company DIS-SYNERGIES (two cost stacks, two boards, two audit/IR functions, typically $30-60M combined) are deducted nowhere, worth roughly $3-5/share of the range; (c) "18%-margin technology-licensing RemainCo" overstates the mix — STS is engineering/consulting plus licensing, the 18.2% margin is right but the licensing framing is not; (d) execution remains conditional and unpriced-for-a-reason: no Form 10 on file as of 2026-08-03, debt split between RemainCo and Trinzic undisclosed (the line concedes this), and the -2% MTS decline means part of the 7.1x is a real judgement on a shrinking government book, not a conglomerate discount. Compounding this, the line itself concedes the re-rate arrives 1-2 quarters AFTER January — so the named date is not the payoff date, which stretches the catalyst window well beyond the event. Forward-not-fired and tradeable (liquid $4.7B NYSE large-cap; the Jan-2027 option strike-adjustment warning is technically correct). Holds as ACTIVE, but at 6, not 7: the facts are clean and the setup is genuinely unharvested — the upside is an unsourced multiple assertion, not a re-derived waterfall.

catalyst_3.title: Verify
catalyst_3.evidence: Kill attempt FAILED on the load-bearing spine, which verifies against primary sources. OppFi 8-K filed 2026-04-29 (event date 2026-04-28, CIK 1818502, accession 0001818502-26-000030) states verbatim: BNCC merges into Birch Merger Sub; each BNCC share converts into $19.375 cash plus an exchange ratio of 1.90 OppFi Class A shares; "the Transaction is valued at approximately $130.7 million"; existing OppFi holders own ~93% and former BNCC holders ~7% of the combined company. So terms, magnitude and split are exact, not approximated. FORWARD confirmed: S-4 registration statement filed 2026-07-27 (accession 0001193125-26-318282) — BNCC shareholder vote and OCC/Fed/FDIC approvals both still outstanding, nothing has fired. AG opposition confirmed independently (PYMNTS, 2026-07-28): 20 state attorneys general asked the Federal Reserve, OCC and FDIC to act on the OppFi and Enova bank deals, combined $499M. Aug 10 catalyst confirmed (PRNewswire 2026-07-28: Q2 results after close Monday 2026-08-10). ALREADY-HARVESTED test PASSED, the strongest part of the line: the pre-announcement close was exactly $9.01 (2026-04-28); announcement day 2026-04-29 closed $9.19, a +2.0% reaction only; last close 2026-08-03 $9.92 = +10.1%, versus a 52wk high of $12.60 (21% below) and a 200d average of $9.29. A definitive agreement public for 97 days that moved the stock 2% on the day and 10% in total is genuinely unpriced, not a re-rate already banked. CORRECTIONS: (1) "spent June below $8" is false — of 15 June closes exactly ONE printed below $8 ($7.84 on 06-08); the June range was $7.84-$9.93 with a median near $8.40. The tape supports "unpriced" without the embellishment, and the embellishment is the tell of a narrative being dressed. (2) "OppFi captures no break fee" is wrong as written — the same 8-K provides that BNCC pays a termination fee of ~3.5% of transaction value on a superior proposal or an adverse board recommendation change. The intended point (no REVERSE break fee if regulators deny) survives, but the sentence as stated is contradicted by the primary filing. (3) NUMERATOR PROVENANCE, the real unaddressed gap: the line asserts "no preferred, no manager, no waterfall," yet Exhibit 10.2 of that same 8-K is a Corporate Simplification Agreement dated 2026-04-28 among OppFi, Opportunity Financial LLC, OppFi Management Holdings, OppFi Shares LLC and the TRA PARTY REPRESENTATIVE. OppFi is an Up-C with a Tax Receivable Agreement — precisely the structure where economics leak to the founder-side unitholders before reaching Class A common. I could not read the simplification terms; declaring "no waterfall" while an Up-C collapse and a TRA sit inside the same deal package is an unearned clean bill. (4) The >25% 2027 / >40% 2028 accretion figures could NOT be verified from a primary filing within budget; they are the entire numerator and remain company-guidance-grade, not confirmed. Note also the market cap already reflects the ~85M economic count ($847M / $9.92 = 85.4M), so the "misleading 26.5M denominator" point affects reported GAAP EPS optics, not the multiple an investor actually pays. Residual risks priced into the cut: the regulatory binary is real and unhedged, the underlying is a ~160% APR subprime lender with live credit-cycle exposure, and Q2 earnings land in 6 days after a +5.9% single-day move on 2026-08-03 that has already harvested part of the gap. Score 7 -> 6.

catalyst_3.evidence: Primary sources confirm the forward leg but correct two load-bearing inputs. (1) The gap the line left open is closable: Vera's own IR announced FDA alignment on the earlier ORIGIN 3 eGFR analysis on JUNE 2, 2026 (eGFR Q3-26, sBLA Q4-26, full approval 2027) — and the stock FELL 7.9% that day, $33.94 (6/1) to $31.26 (6/2). Today's $32.23 is +3.1% vs that true pre-catalyst base, so 0%-harvested is CONFIRMED and is in fact stronger than the line's $40.13 proxy implies. But it also reframes the de-rate: the -19.7% from pre-PDUFA $40.13 (7/6) to $32.23 is a round-trip of the approval pop back to the pre-alignment level, i.e. franchise repricing as the 6th approved IgAN drug (Fabhalta, Voyxact, Filspari, Tarpeyo already selling), not "the market discounting competition while the binary sits unpriced." A positive eGFR print converts accelerated to full approval — confirming a nod already granted — while an adverse print puts a live, already-approved franchise at withdrawal risk. That is negative convexity, and the line's bull case does not price it. (2) Cash is misstated in the conservative direction: $596.8M cash/marketable securities at 3/31/26 with ~$106.5M/qtr operating burn, not "~$300M net cash" — runway past the readout is CONFIRMED and then some, but EV is nearer ~$1.85-1.9B than $2.0B off the $2.31B market cap. Numerator provenance is clean: no preferred stack, no PIK, no external manager, no waterfall ahead of the common beyond a term facility, so the derived value would accrue to the equity. Score cut 7 to 6: G3 remains unmet (the ~$58 is a self-derived franchise build, not a disclosed unpriced figure), the milestone is quarter-dated and can slip to end-Q3/Q4, and the pulled-forward analysis trades eGFR-slope follow-up for speed — the very trade the tape voted against on 6/2.

catalyst_3.title: Verify
catalyst_3.evidence: Event survives: Aquestive's own 2026-05-13 Q1 release states verbatim that the Jan-30-2026 CRL "identified deficiencies in two areas: human factors validation and pharmacokinetics (PK) studies," that it "did not identify any chemistry, manufacturing, or controls (CMC) deficiencies," that "clinical results supporting comparability to auto-injectors were not questioned," and it "reaffirms guidance to resubmit ... in the third quarter of 2026." Unfired as of 2026-08-03 (no resubmission PR; latest news is only the 07-29 earnings-date notice). Not harvested: $3.78 vs 50d $4.12, 200d $4.70, 52wk high $7.55, 52wk low $2.93 — the +39% CRL-relief pop fully round-tripped. CORRECTIONS: (1) NUMERATOR PROVENANCE IS WRONG, not clean — "net debt only $22.8M / nothing ahead of the common" is false. At 3/31/26 the company carried notes payable $25.1M + loans payable $13.7M against $110.7M cash, but ALSO a $63.1M liability related to sale of future revenue and $26.9M royalty obligations — i.e. ~$90M of structurally senior claims on the very product cash flows, plus the 05-12 Oaktree refinancing that funded $55M at signing (principal deferred to 2031, $20M more unlocked only on Anaphylm approval). Senior claims are ~$145M, not $22.8M. It is not preferred stock and the common is still the honest instrument, but the "provenance is clean" leg of the thesis does not survive. (2) The "Class 2 / ~6-month clock / FDA action ~Q1-2027" is pure inference — the company gave no Class 1/2 language and said only that it "will request an accelerated review upon resubmission, though no expedited review can be guaranteed." (3) Shares 124.3M, not 125.5M. (4) Checkpoint date is off by one: Q2 results post-close Tue Aug 11, call Wed Aug 12 8:00 ET. Residual risks unrefuted: resubmission is conditioned on completing the two studies with no public confirmation the HF validation study is done; a novel sublingual-film presentation is exactly where HF validation can fail twice; securities class action (period 2025-06-16 to 2026-01-08) live.

valuation.valuation_basis: RE-APPROVAL binary, not a primary-efficacy coin-flip. Anaphylm (sublingual epinephrine film) received a NARROW CRL on 2026-01-30 limited to Human Factors (pouch-opening/film-placement) + a supportive PK study + labeling — company states explicitly NO CMC issues and auto-injector comparability NOT questioned (8-K 2026-01-30). Type A meeting completed; FDA gave clarifying HF/PK feedback; resubmission guided Q3-2026 with rapid-review request (investors.aquestive). Because the deficiencies are fixable/procedural, win_prob 0.70. On approval the equity re-rates toward sell-side consensus $9 (range $6-$12, FMP); sublingual epi displaces autoinjectors in a multi-$B allergy market, plus Libervant/Sympazan revenue underpins. On a second CRL the single-catalyst thesis breaks and the stock reverts to pre-CRL distress. Cash $110.7M, net debt $22.8M (Q1-26), ~99.3M sh — NOT pure cash, so floor set at pre-CRL/52wk-low stress ~$2.75 (52wk low $2.93). target_on_win $8.50. EV% = 0.70*(8.5-3.895)/3.895 + 0.30*(2.75-3.895)/3.895 = +0.74.
valuation.prob_basis: CRL is procedural/narrow (HF + supportive PK + labeling; NO CMC, comparability intact) per 2026-01-30 8-K; Type A feedback received, resubmit Q3-2026. Re-approval of an otherwise-complete file => 0.70.

catalyst_3.title: Verify
catalyst_3.evidence: All load-bearing facts confirmed against primary company releases: the June 29, 2026 PR states verbatim that "The Agency has not requested additional data" and guides BLA submission to Q3 2026; the July 16, 2026 Q2 release confirms $174.9M cash at June 30, 2026 funding into Q3 2027; July 17, 2026 confirms the $150M ATM shelf and July 30, 2026 confirms the ~$50M ADS sale to RA Capital via Citizens JMP, leaving ~$100M capacity. Capital structure is clean (French SA, ordinary shares in 5:1 ADS, no preferred, no PIK, no external manager), and the already-harvested test passes hard in the line's favor: at $13.37 the stock is 49% below the $26.185 52-week high, 17% below the $16.18 50dma and 27% below the $18.24 200dma, with market cap $319.8M against ~$200M pro-forma cash, i.e. ~$120M EV — the payoff has been given back, not captured. Two corrections. (1) "Efficacy risk is spent" overstates the de-risking: VITESSE efficacy is indeed behind, but DBV's history of FDA failure on Viaskin is CMC/patch-adhesion and application-quality, not efficacy, and that risk is entirely un-spent — the June 29 language ("take additional time to incorporate the FDA feedback") is precisely a quality-of-dossier signal, and it slipped guidance rather than confirming it. (2) The "clean waterfall / ~$8.40 net-cash floor" argument understates the actual leak to the common: DBV executed $50M into weakness at ~$13-14 rather than defending the tape, and the remaining ~$100M open ATM is roughly a third of the current market cap — issuance at these levels is the waterfall dilution, so the net-cash-per-ADS floor erodes on every draw rather than holding. The dated forward event is an administrative submission, not the value event (a mid-2027 PDUFA that will very likely require another raise); acceptance/priority-review determination in Q4 2026 is the only clock that pays inside the window. Score trimmed 6 to 5.5 on the un-spent CMC risk plus the mechanical ATM supply cap through the catalyst.

valuation.company_note: BARBELL. Win ($34/sh): approval + launch into large US pediatric peanut-allergy market (~1.5-2M children); first epicutaneous option vs oral Palforzia (which flopped commercially -> caps upside) -> $700M-1.2B EV. Loss ($9.50/sh): CRL -> new trial/cash burn, floor near but below cash/share ($229.2M/23.9M=$9.59). Expected EV = 0.55x$34 + 0.45x$9.50 = $18.70+$4.28 = $22.98 vs ref $16.06 -> +43% (binary EV%). ATTRACTIVE asymmetric barbell: efficacy de-risked, ~$9.5 cash floor limits downside to ~-41% vs ~+112% on win. reference_rr shown as EV% (+0.43).

candidates.instrument: common equity (NASDAQ: SVRA); single-asset binary, so position size is the risk control, not a stop
candidates.analysis_summary: [MILESTONE] PDUFA goal date Nov 22 2026 (extended Apr 15 2026 from Aug 22 2026 on a three-month major-amendment clock reset); ~110 days forward as of 2026-08-03. | The flag's hard facts check out: the PDUFA really did reset to Nov 22 2026 on a major amendment, the FDA cited no safety, efficacy or CMC deficiency in the extension letter, the drug carries Priority Review plus Breakthrough and Fast Track and Orphan designations, and the stock is 12% BELOW its pre-announcement base rather than above it - so the event is fully forward and essentially unharvested, which is why this clears to ACTIVE at all. But I dock the flag's central inference: "no concerns cited" is boilerplate that appears in nearly every major-amendment extension release and is not evidence of de-risking, and it reads worse here because Savara's FIRST BLA cycle was scuppered by third-party manufacturing/CMC problems before the Dec-2025 resubmission - a company on its second cycle slipping a second time is the classic prelude to a CRL, not a signal the review is clean. Combined with a re-derived approval value of ~$8.75 against a ~$2.75 CRL floor (R:R ~1.33:1) on a single-asset issuer with eight analysts already on the name, this is a real, dated, unpriced-in-price-terms binary with an ordinary-quality payoff, not an edge case; G3 fails and the score reflects that.

catalyst_3.title: Verify
catalyst_3.evidence: Core verified, two corrections. VERIFIED vs primary: $35.00/sh all-cash Hapag-Lloyd merger, ~$4.2B, 126% premium to the $15.50 unaffected price (Aug-8-2025), close guided "late 2026" subject to "approvals by regulatory authorities and the State of Israel pursuant to the requirements of the Special State Share" (ZIM/PRNewswire deal release); ~97.36% holder approval; Jul-6-2026 ZIM update quoted exactly — "The Company continues to act in accordance with the agreement and in ongoing collaboration with the relevant state authorities as part of the regulatory review process," with NO outside date, break fee, or timing given. Live quote $26.07 (52wk 12.33-29.97) → 34.3% gross spread, arithmetic correct. Undated sovereign gate confirmed: Defense Ministry recommended opposing, Defense Minister Katz invoked the golden share, Netanyahu said the deal is "not on the agenda"; The Loadstar's base case is the deal FAILS at the golden-share hurdle. CORRECTION 1 — the line's stated gap ("neither the outside/termination date nor the break fee is publicly disclosed") is wrong as framed: a $150M break fee was reported and is understood to have lapsed once holders voted, and the executed merger agreement is filed on EDGAR (zk2634378.htm), so these are unlooked-at, not undisclosed. CORRECTION 2 — the line omits that Israeli businessman Haim Sakal bid ~$4.5B / $37.50 per share (~May-2026, ~7% above Hapag-Lloyd) and the board rejected it as the signed deal remains enforceable post-vote; a second party willing to pay ABOVE $35 materially softens the "market prices a break well below $20" break-case framing the score rests on. NEW, unmentioned: Jul-28-2026 EGM adopted a new director/officer compensation policy and an employment agreement for newly appointed President & CEO Chen Lichtenstein — standalone-continuity housekeeping unusual for a company days from a cash close; Q2 prints Aug-19-2026. The ALREADY-HARVESTED attack FAILS here: from the $15.50 unaffected base only ~54% of the $19.50 move is captured, ~46% remains, and the stock sits 13% below its 52wk high after the Jul-6 de-rate — this is a de-rated spread, not a harvested one. NUMERATOR PROVENANCE PASSES: contractual all-cash consideration paid directly to the common with no preferred ahead of it, so no waterfall leakage — the skeptic ran the right check. Not fired, forward, liquid ($3.1B cap, 1.28M sh/day). Score trimmed below the flagged 6 because the resolving milestone is a discretionary, undated national-security decision actively opposed at PM and Defense-Minister level, and the modeled "$29-30 asset floor" remains the weakest leg — GAAP book is inflated by right-of-use charter tonnage, though ~$2.6B cash (~$21.6/sh) does anchor a real, lower floor.

Close expected Q4/late-2026; outside date 2/17/27 (extendable to 6/30/27 for regulatory). I split the difference at 50%. Floor = undisturbed standalone ~$18 (mid-cycle container liner, highly cyclical; pre-deal trade ~$18-22). Source: deal FAQ/PR investors.zim.com; outside date 2/17/27.

BUT the load-bearing structural claim — "the equity behind the event is clean... no capital-structure trap between the event and the common, $36.7M net cash... the one real haircut is the 30.3% minority" — is refuted by a primary PR the line never cites: on 04-May-2026, EIGHT DAYS BEFORE the NDA acceptance, Gyre CLOSED the acquisition of Cullgen in an "approximately $300 million ALL-STOCK transaction" — a ~55%-of-market-cap equity issuance for a preclinical protein-degrader pipeline. Line's own admissions (no stated decision date; Q4-26/H1-27 window is inference, not primary) are accurate and already correct. Score cut 7 to 4: real, dated, forward, genuinely unpriced event on a broken numerator with a governance overhang and an 18% float.

catalyst_3.title: Verify
catalyst_3.evidence: Primary check clears the scaffolding but guts the underwriting. CONFIRMED vs primary: SB 254 (Becker) chaptered 2025-09-19 as an urgency statute, and its text does order the Wildfire Fund Administrator "on or before April 1, 2026" to submit recommendations on "new models or approaches ... to complement or replace the fund" (leginfo, 202520260SB254) — the line's cited hook is real, correctly dated, and still forward. Not FIRED: as of 2026-08-03/04 nothing has passed. Not harvested: PCG $17.43 vs 200d $16.71 (+4.3%), 50d $17.00, 52wk range $14.14-$19.16 (9% BELOW the high) — no announcement re-rate has been captured, so attack (7) fails. Valuation arithmetic is honest: $17.43 / reaffirmed 2026 guidance $1.64-$1.66 (Q2 print 2026-07-23, core EPS $0.40 beat) = 10.6x exactly as claimed. WHAT FAILS: (a) THE VEHICLE DOES NOT EXIST IN READABLE FORM. The line flagged this as its own gap; verification confirms it is the whole case. Contemporaneous coverage (E&E/POLITICO 2026-07-27 "Newsom administration pushing for California wildfire liability changes"; POLITICO 2026-08-03 "The election-year gamble behind California's wildfire talks") describes an unfiled, still-negotiated administration proposal, not a bill. With no text there are no terms, so attack (3) terms/magnitude-truth is entirely UNDISCHARGED — nobody, including the underwriter, can state what the "fix" delivers to the common. An event you cannot read is not a 6. (b) NEW DISQUALIFYING-GRADE OPPOSITION the line never priced: CalMatters 2026-07-30, "LA fire survivors say Newsom is trying to help utilities reduce their wildfire costs again," with the prior-cycle precedent framed as "effectively a bailout." Organized victim opposition plus an election year is precisely the configuration that produces the line's own admitted failure mode — a diluted bill that technically passes and re-rates nothing. (c) TWO LOAD-BEARING QUOTES UNVERIFIED against primary: the Poppe "if the legislature does not act..." line and, more seriously, the claim that S&P and Moody's have PUBLICLY named reform as the upgrade trigger. I could confirm only management's characterization on the Q2 call (MarketBeat call coverage: executives called reform "a critical factor for the utility's capital plans and path to investment-grade credit ratings"), never an agency publication. Management asserting what its raters require is not a rating-agency commitment. (d) MECHANISM HAIRCUT the line concedes but does not score: a ratings ladder over 2-4 quarters is not a catalyst print; even a clean August pass yields no dated repricing event, which collapses the Sep/Oct call alternative outright. (e) Minor date correction: Aug 31 2026 is the final floor/adjournment deadline of the 2025-26 session, not a "house-passage deadline" (house-of-origin deadlines fell earlier in the cycle). MISSED FACT that mildly helps the credit leg: PG&E ran a cash tender for its 2027 notes 2026-07-27 through 07-31, upsized $1.0B to $1.2B — real deleveraging the line did not cite. Net: a genuine, unfired, unpriced-at-10.6x optionality on an unwritten bill facing funded opposition, paying off through a slow ratings channel. Real, but 4 — not 6.

Total debt $2.952B vs cash $1.193B = $1.759B net debt (levered up from $983M at 2025-12-31 via a ~$2.18B spin distribution to Comcast), against a $5.21B market cap, so EV ~$7.08B; on ~$2.0B adjusted EBITDA that is ~3.5x, and Q1 FCF $558M / Q4 FCF $430M supports a mid-20s% levered FCF yield, so the flagged "~3x FCF" survives scrutiny - the FIP failure mode (pref stack eating the common) does NOT apply here. What fails is the catalyst test, not the arithmetic: there is no dated event with a specific unpriced resolution - an earnings print is a two-sided disclosure, the buyback is a continuous program, and "index-ineligible holders finish dumping" is undated and unverifiable, while the price action says that flow is already ~35% reversed and back at trend. Capped at 4 under the residual-capture rule (the specific dislocation flagged is mostly worked off) and because the residual upside is a re-rating bet on a melting-ice-cube carrying $7.7B of goodwill on a $12.5B balance sheet - impairment and affiliate-fee erosion are the live risks, and the low multiple is the market's terminal-value verdict, not a mispricing waiting on a trigger.

valuation.valuation_basis: Barbell on obicetrapib (CETP inhibitor). LDL franchise already de-risked: BROADWAY/BROOKLYN/TANDEM Phase 3 positive (35-50% LDL-C lowering), EMA MAA VALIDATED/accepted (Menarini-filed), EMA/UK/Swiss decisions 2H26. NAMS retains US economics (the prize); EU via Menarini royalties (low-double to mid-20s% + up to EUR863M milestones). Cash $707.3M (3/31/26), 116.9M sh (~$6/sh net cash). WIN (EU approval + supportive PREVAIL -> obicetrapib becomes a CV-outcomes statin-adjunct, 7MM peak ~$1.4B+, US-owned): re-rate to ~$60 (top of analyst range $37.77-$59.33; Street median $47.51; William Blair FV $43; one analyst 90% PoS, >100% upside). LOSE (PREVAIL fails to show CV benefit -> niche LDL-lowering only, value collapses toward cash + modest EU royalty stream): ~$14. win_prob 0.55 calibrated: near-term EU approval ~90% (drug works, MAA validated) but the price-defining CVOT leg is a true coin-flip-plus (CETP class has a graveyard, but obicetrapib has clean LDL + ApoB data and ongoing Alzheimer's biomarker signal). EV = 0.55*60 + 0.45*14 = ~$39, below spot $31 only if you weight downside heavier; at 0.55 EV>spot.
valuation.prob_basis: Blended: ~90% near-term EU/UK/Swiss approval (Phase 3 LDL data positive + EMA MAA already validated) x ~0.6 conditional on the value-defining PREVAIL CVOT showing MACE benefit (CETP-class historical failures offset by obicetrapib's clean LDL/ApoB profile and Alzheimer's biomarker signal); one sell-side analyst assigns 90% PoS. Calibrated to 0.55 for the full re-rate.
